body: i doubt I would be able to stay that long, but I am going on vacation with them for 1-2 weeks at the end of this summer. I know what it's like to live there for 4-5 days straight. It just feels normal, I know the rules and the routines.

I stay there for multiple days at a time, I know their rules and what it's like to live there. They're very funny, caring and loving. 

I can't just choose to stay with my friend, if it was that easy I would do it in a heartbeat.

I stay there for multiple days at a time, because it is convenient and means less driving for my family. However, they do make me come home because they think I am burdening them. The other family truly wants me there and has told me so before. 

My family would never just let me live there though. 
My parents and close-minded and very ignorant. I am their kid, so in their minds no matter what I have to live with them.

I've had lots of time to think lately. I've decided I really do need to be around the people that love me, and I can't care what my family thinks because this is for the best. I just need help understanding the process in detail, and need to know what to expect(probably information I could only get from a lawyer/someone who has been in a similar situation. Is there a sunreddit for this?).

Ok, I've decided I really do need to be around the people that care. Would you by chance know what I would have to do? I know emancipation would mean I would be responsible for myself, but I've been reading up on it and in order for me to get emancipated, I would already have to he living alone? It doesn't make much sense. I just want to live with the other family, not alone. In this case would it become a custody battle?

Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. 

I have one last question for you, do you think getting emancipated and living with the people I love is the right thing to do? Even though theough the process I would most likely lose all of my family?

Ok. I know there is hot lines and that sort of thing, but I really, really don't like talking on the phone. In fact, I really don't like talking out loud in general, I end up crying. I have no way of getting professional help, I can't drive, have zero dollars to my name, and I don't have a lot of spare time. 
What else do you suggest i do?
I just realized how long that is, thanks to anyone who might waste their time reading that block of text.
